search.note: Search query. Fuzzy search, supports LinkedIn's search operators

currentCompanies.note: Filter by current company IDs or URLs. Comma-separated (max 50)

pastCompanies.note: Filter by past company IDs or URLs. Comma-separated (max 50)

geoIds.note: Filter by LinkedIn Geo ID. Comma-separated. Overrides location param. Use /linkedin/geo-id-search to find IDs

schools.note: Filter by school IDs or URLs. Comma-separated (max 50)

currentJobTitles.note: Filter by current job titles. Comma-separated (max 70)

pastJobTitles.note: Filter by past job titles. Comma-separated (max 70)

industryIds.note: Filter by industry IDs. Comma-separated (max 70). Full list: https://github.com/HarvestAPI/linkedin-industry-codes-v2/blob/main/linkedin_industry_code_v2_all_eng_with_header.csv

yearsAtCurrentCompanyIds.note: Filter by years at current company IDs. Comma-separated. https://github.com/HarvestAPI/harvestapi-sdk/blob/main/packages/scraper/README.md#yearsatcurrentcompanyids

yearsOfExperienceIds.note: Filter by years of experience IDs. Comma-separated. https://github.com/HarvestAPI/harvestapi-sdk/blob/main/packages/scraper/README.md#yearsofexperienceids

seniorityLevelIds.note: Filter by seniority level IDs. Comma-separated. https://github.com/HarvestAPI/harvestapi-sdk/blob/main/packages/scraper/README.md#senioritylevelids

functionIds.note: Filter by job function IDs. Comma-separated. https://github.com/HarvestAPI/harvestapi-sdk/blob/main/packages/scraper/README.md#functionids

recentlyChangedJobs.note: Filter leads who recently changed jobs in the last 90 days.

postedOnLinkedin.note: Filter leads who posted on LinkedIn in the last 30 days

companyHeadquarterLocations.note: Filter by company headquarter location text. Comma-separated (max 70)

excludeLocations.note: Locations to exclude from search. Comma-separated (max 70)

excludeGeoIds.note: Geo IDs to exclude from search. Comma-separated (max 70)

excludeCurrentJobTitles.note: Current job titles to exclude. Comma-separated (max 70)

excludePastJobTitles.note: Past job titles to exclude. Comma-separated (max 70)

excludeSeniorityLevelIds.note: Seniority level IDs to exclude. Comma-separated (max 20)

excludeCompanyHeadquarterLocations.note: Company headquarter locations to exclude from search. Comma-separated (max 70)

input.note: Use only the declared query parameters, once each, without a request body. Results are provider-native: inspect element/elements and body status/error; HTTP 200 alone does not prove a hit. Empty results can still be charged. Returns 25 rows per page in live tests; page is capped at 100. Private account/session and Sales Navigator URL overrides are outside this tool.

cost.note: Observed on treg’s prepaid Harvest account. Final platform cost follows the response cost, including billed misses and explicit zero. BYOK never charges the treg balance.
